<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def get_player_pos():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels'] == 24:
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rows), min(cols))
    return None

pos = get_player_pos()
print(f"At {pos}")

# Try SPACE
result = action(['SPACE'])
new_pos = get_player_pos()
print(f"SPACE: {pos} -> {new_pos}")
print(f"Result: level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}, done={last_action_result.get('done')}")

# Check for gray nodes (checkpoints)
seg = current_frame.segmentation
gray_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'g']
print(f"Gray nodes: {len(gray_nodes)}")
for n in gray_nodes:
    b = n['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    print(f"  id={n['id']}, pixels={n['pixels']}, pos=({min(rows)},{min(cols)}), hash={n['hash']}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
